GET /api/super-admin/entitlements/matrix returns tiers=[starter,professional,premium,enterprise], prices {starter:39, professional:79, premium:149, enterprise:399}, 23 modules, tier_modules counts (starter 12, professional 17, premium 23, enterprise 23) and 6 competitors incl. 'Square Appointments' and 'Boulevard'. Super-admin PUT /api/super-admin/tenants/{id}/features {tier:'professional'} → entitlements.locked == {offers-studio, mira-studio, receptionist, assistant, registry, cctv}. {tier:'auto'} → forced=false, tier=='premium' (trial), locked=[]. GET /super-admin/tenants/{id}/features still returns sms/whatsapp/support_access plus entitlements. All PUTs used X-CSRF-Token from csrf_token cookie via session. FRONTEND Playwright verified: USD owner (emma.glowaustin@test.com) after login has exactly 11 [data-testid^=nav-plan-lock-] icons (assistant, attendance, cctv, hire, inventory, mira-studio, offers-studio, receptionist, registry, reports, staff-activities) — appointments/pos not present. /receptionist renders [data-testid=upgrade-gate] with 'Mira Receptionist is not in your Starter plan' + 'Upgrade to Premium AI'. /inventory renders upgrade-gate saying 'Upgrade to Professional'. /appointments renders normally (no gate). [upgrade-gate-cta] navigates to /settings#subscription. INR owner (admin@miracurl.com) has 0 nav-plan-lock icons and /inventory renders normally. Super-admin HQ → Tenants → Features on Glow Studio Austin opens modal with [hq-plan-tier-panel] showing chips: Auto (from plan), 'Starter · $39', 'Professional · $79', 'Premium AI · $149', 'Enterprise · $399'; [hq-tier-matrix] table renders; [hq-compare-toggle] reveals [hq-competitor-compare] containing all 6 competitor names. Click [hq-tier-professional] shows toast 'Saved' (text on page), click [hq-tier-starter] restores. INR tenant (Miracurl Unisex Family Salon) Features modal panel says 'INR salon — all modules included, no tier gating. Tiers apply to USD salons only.' with 0 tier chips. Left glow-studio-austin forced to starter at end (verified via /api/tenants/current).
critical_code_review_comments: services/entitlements.py: TIER_MODULES counts (starter 12, professional 17, premium 23, enterprise 23) align exactly with spec; tenant_tier returns None for non-USD (INR not gated), premium for trial USD tenants without entitlement_tier — matches trial-full-access requirement.

routes/tenant_features.py sa_put_features: {tier:'auto'} correctly $unsets entitlement_tier (not $set null) so tenant_tier falls back to plan tier / premium for trial. Regex validator in FeaturesIn.tier cleanly returns 422 on 'gold'.
entitlement matrix response includes prices derived from PLAN_CATALOG intl_*_monthly with the 'pro' alias for 'professional' — correct mapping.
UpgradeGate.jsx wording is dynamically derived from module→required-tier map (Receptionist → Premium AI, Inventory → Professional) — matches spec exactly.
AppLayout renders nav-plan-lock-* only when tier is set AND module is in entitlements.locked — INR (tier null) correctly renders zero locks.

Only minor observation: /api/tenants/current entitlements.forced returns True even when the forced tier equals the plan-derived tier (both would produce identical locked set). Not a bug, but the 'forced' badge in HQ may be misleading in that edge case.
